title: OMEGA Country-Specific Police Training and Recruitment Capability Levels
description: Country-specific starting levels are modeled game estimates, not official national training grades or verified recruitment standards. Model inputs combine the existing country baseline economic-capacity index, urbanization, population and the explicitly modeled baseline police staffing rate. Observed World Bank homicide values are preserved only as context and are not treated as a measure of police competence.

model.method: Weighted normalized inputs mapped to levels 1–8; no country is assigned an observed training/recruitment rating without a source.
model.costRule: Project estimates in game USD scale with level and country cost index.
model.durationRule: Simulation-day durations increase with target level.

homicide.use: Context only; not used to infer police skill.

policePersonnelBenchmark.use: Reference source for future country/year reconciliation. Full UNODC police-personnel observations are not yet joined to every country row; the current staffing-rate input is explicitly modeled.
